title: GENADA: efficient generative time series adversarial attack framework
abstract: arXiv:2608.12535v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep learning models are widely used for time series analysis in domains such as healthcare, finance, energy systems, and environmental monitoring. However, these models remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks, where small input perturbations cause severe degradation in predictive performance. Commonly used gradient-based attacks, iterative first-order methods, are computationally burdensome, as they repeatedly backpropagate through the victim model to compute input gradients during a number of iterative refinement steps. We propose a GENerative ADversarial Attack (GENADA) that learns a generative model to produce deceptive perturbations directly in a single forward pass and a procedure to train it. Variants include single-step and iterative generative attack schemes. translated_title: GENADA：高效生成式时间序列对抗攻击框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12535v1 公告类型：新  摘要：深度学习模型广泛应用于医疗、金融、能源系统和环境监测等领域的时间序列分析。然而，这些模型仍然容易受到对抗攻击，即小的输入扰动会导致预测性能严重下降。常用的基于梯度的攻击方法，如迭代一阶方法，计算负担沉重，因为它们需要在多次迭代细化步骤中反复通过受害模型进行反向传播以计算输入梯度。我们提出了一种生成式对抗攻击（GENADA），该方法学习一个生成模型，在单次前向传播中直接产生欺骗性扰动，并设计了一个训练该模型的流程。变体包括单步和迭代生成式攻击方案。验证考虑了在时间序列领域中针对多个神经模型和数据集的攻击，以及一个受控的低维设置。实验表明，GENADA实现了与现有方法相当的攻击性能。
tldr: GENADA提出了一种基于生成模型的对抗攻击框架，通过单次前向传播直接生成扰动，显著降低了计算成本，同时保持了与迭代梯度方法相当的攻击效果。
en_tdlr: GENADA proposes a generative-model-based adversarial attack framework that generates perturbations in a single forward pass, significantly reducing computational cost while maintaining attack performance comparable to iterative gradient methods.
